biggest_catch: You get nothing until your friend opens a PrimeWay personal checking account AND completes within 60 days both $500+ in direct deposits and 5+ debit card transactions (ATM excluded).
catches: Complete the referral registration form or call 888-626-3882 to create a referral profile, then enter your friend or family member's name and email address.

Friend must open a new PrimeWay personal checking account and, within 60 days of account opening, receive one or more direct deposits totaling $500 AND make five or more debit card transactions (ATM transactions excluded).
Referrer can earn up to $500 per calendar year (five $100 cards).
Fetched page text does not state payout timing or tax treatment; no fee to refer stated.
